scenario_description:
Objective: Finish tactile-overlay binder assembly already underway for the 15:00 Harborview route-change review table.
Emerging Need: The assembly moves from collating into tactile labeling, then stops when the prepared swell-touch sheet pack is damaged and ordinary paper cannot substitute.
Decision Context: The van handoff is close, partial binders will not meet the handling-table need, and stored supply records identify the only releasable replacement source and cutoff.
Consequence: Clearing the material blockage before the van departs could preserve the started binders; afterward, late overlays cannot reach the session.

parameter.title: Tactile overlay binder assembly
parameter.description: Collate route-change review binders and add tactile overlay sheets before the 14:20 van handoff for the public handling table.

parameter.content: We're in Room B with the route-change binders open. First three are collated and I'm starting the tactile overlay sheets now.

parameter.subject: Handling-table binders for today
parameter.body: For the 15:00 route-change review, the handling table needs the tactile overlay version; paper-only copies can go to the general stack but won't satisfy the accessible-review set. The senior center van is still the planned carrier.

parameter.content: The shrink wrap on the remaining swell-touch packet was sliced and the sheets are curled and adhesive-stuck. The embosser feed rejects them, so the nine remaining binders are stopped at the tactile-label step; regular inserts fit but won't take the raised overlay.

parameter.subject: Van loading window
parameter.body: The driver is taking meeting materials at the side door until 14:20 sharp; after that the van goes straight to the 15:00 route-change review with no second run.

parameter.content: Driver just left with the three complete binders and the paper-only extras. They said no one is returning here before the review starts.
